lesson.title: 4.11 Ana uses it
lesson.unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
lesson.goal: Use it and them after a verb instead of repeating the thing (Ana gives it to her friend. / She makes them.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.11 Everyday Verbs: A1 says what people make, use, find and give; A1+ 4.11 replaces the thing with it or them after the verb (Ana uses the computer. / Ana uses it.), after A1+ 1.11's him, her and them after with; with give, it goes before to and the person (Ana gives it to her friend.). It or them is decided by how many things the photo shows: one computer, book, phone or cat; several eggs, shoes, apples or cups. A1 4.11's photos of Ana and of a family giving a book to their daughter, and A1+ 2.10's photos of Sofia, Ana and Diego holding the shoes, apples and cups they chose, are reused.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 4.11 make, use, find, give; A1+ 1.11 him, her, them after with; A1+ 2.10 the chosen groups.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Link the verb and it (USE-zit, GIVE-zit); them is short (thum). Do not require native-like speed.
